Twitch Subscription Calculator

Twitch subscriptions pay the streamer a fixed monthly amount per active sub, depending on tier. Standard split is 50% of the list price (Tier 1 $4.99 → $2.50, Tier 2 $9.99 → $5.00, Tier 3 $24.99 → $12.50). Prime subs count like Tier 1 subs but with a variable token value. This calculator rolls up monthly sub revenue and shows take-home.

Why subs matter more than views

Subscriptions are the predictable floor of a streaming income: they recur monthly and are less volatile than ads or tips. A 1,000-sub Tier-1 channel earns about $2,500/month from subs alone — roughly equivalent to 300k–600k YouTube long-form views per month. Add Bits as the variable upside (typically 20–40% on top).

Frequently asked questions

How much does Twitch pay per sub?

Standard split: $2.50 (Tier 1), $5.00 (Tier 2), $12.50 (Tier 3) per sub per month. Partners can negotiate higher splits; Prime subs pay a variable token value (historically ~$2.50).

Do gifted subs pay the same?

Yes — a gifted Tier 1 sub pays the streamer the same $2.50/month for its duration.
